description: This file defines an abstract class 'MediaSourceBase' for media source plugins in Drupal, including methods for configuration, metadata retrieval, field management, and display preparation.

classes.name: MediaSourceBase
classes.description: An abstract base class for media source plugins, providing common functionality for configuration, metadata, field management, and display handling within Drupal's media module.

methods.name: setConfiguration
methods.description: Sets the plugin's configuration by merging default and provided configurations.

methods.name: defaultConfiguration
methods.description: Provides default configuration values, such as 'source_field'.

methods.name: getMetadata
methods.description: Retrieves metadata attributes for a media entity, such as default name, thumbnail URI, and link target.

methods.name: calculateDependencies
methods.description: Returns an array of dependencies; default is empty.

methods.name: getSourceFieldOptions
methods.description: Returns available source field options for media entities, filtered by allowed field types.

methods.name: buildConfigurationForm
methods.description: Builds a form for configuring the media source, including source field selection.

methods.name: validateConfigurationForm
methods.description: Placeholder for validation logic of the configuration form.

methods.name: submitConfigurationForm
methods.description: Handles submission of the configuration form, saving settings and creating source fields if needed.

methods.name: createSourceFieldStorage
methods.description: Creates a new field storage configuration for the source field.

methods.name: getSourceFieldStorage
methods.description: Retrieves the existing source field storage definition, if any.

methods.name: getSourceFieldDefinition
methods.description: Gets the field definition for the source field for a given media type.

methods.name: createSourceField
methods.description: Creates a new field configuration for a media type.

methods.name: getSourceFieldName
methods.description: Generates or retrieves the name of the source field, ensuring uniqueness.

methods.name: getSourceFieldValue
methods.description: Retrieves the value of the source field from a media entity.

methods.name: prepareViewDisplay
methods.description: Prepares the display of media for viewing, setting label visibility.

methods.name: prepareFormDisplay
methods.description: Prepares the form display of media, positioning the source field.
